bias.en: Bearish · broke $295, lowest close since March, RSI oversold
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $295，创 3月以来最低收盘，RSI 超卖

read.en: Teradyne fell 7.4% on Oct 30 to $274.37, its lowest close since Mar 6, trading between $266.39 and $284.16 on 2.7 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($303.3), 10-day ($315.2), 30-day ($368.6) and 100-day ($374.8) averages and the rising 200-day ($349.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($322.58), and RSI is 29, oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月30日下跌 7.4%，收于 $274.37，为 3月6日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $266.39–284.16，成交量为均量的 2.7 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$303.3）、10 日（$315.2）、30 日（$368.6）和 100 日均线（$374.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$349.5）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$322.58），RSI 为 29，处于超卖区。

read.en: Two more losses broke all three written supports, $309.4 (May 19 low), $304.3–306.4 and $295–296.8, now resistance. Resistance is $295–296.8, then $303.3–304.3 (5-day, Oct 23 low) and $315.2–317 (10-day, Oct 28 high). Support is $273.1 (Mar 30 low), then $262.3–266.4 (Oct 30 low, Feb and Mar lows) and $240.7–241 (Jan 28 and Feb 2 lows). A close above $296.8 would target $303–304; below $262, $241.
